blind.description: A stylized wooden bakery display bookcase unit with a closed paneled back and four tiers of shelves including the top. The shelves are fully stocked with bakery goods: the top surface holds a decorated frosted cake with berries and leaves, a cluster of dinner rolls on a red napkin, and a scored round loaf of bread; the inner three shelves are packed with loaves of bread, bread baskets, buns, and another cake on the bottom shelf. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and styled with warm hand-painted textures in brown wood and golden-brown pastry tones.
blind.from_above: A narrow rectangular wooden top viewed directly overhead, displaying a round frosted cake with green and red toppings, a cluster of four golden rolls sitting on a red rectangular cloth, and a large round loaf of scored bread.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 feet tall (reaching just below the shoulders of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 feet wide by 1.5 feet deep.
